newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area on Tuesday. Slaughter steers and heifers mostly steady, USDA said.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Sales reported on 22,600 slaughter steers and 13,900 heifers; 55,700 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 11,800 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Slaughter Steers Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 66.00-67.50.
Slaughter Heifers Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 68.00. Pen Select, few Choice 1100 lbs 67.00.
Wk to Date: 55,700 Week Ago: 20,200 Year Ago: 28,200
